\code{AW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_ADDR_WIDTH} (\code{32}) & 1 or more & Width of an address. The default is the width of the AXI package.\\
\code{DW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_DATA_WIDTH} (\code{32}) & an AXI data width & Width of the data. The default is the width of the AXI package.\\
\code{SW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_STRB_WIDTH} (\code{4}) & DW / 8 by convention & Width of the write strobe. The default is the width of the AXI package.\\
\code{LENW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_LEN_WIDTH} (\code{8}) & 1 or more & Width of the burst length field. The default is the width of the AXI package.\\
\code{SIZEW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_SIZE_WIDTH} (\code{3}) & 1 or more & Width of the burst size field. The default is the width of the AXI package.\\
\code{AW_DEPTH} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{4} & power of two, 2 or more & Number of entries of the write address FIFO. The FIFO module stops elaboration for any other value. The test suite uses depths of 4 and more.\\
\code{W_DEPTH} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{8} & power of two, 2 or more & Number of entries of the write data FIFO. The FIFO module stops elaboration for any other value. The test suite uses depths of 4 and more.\\
\code{B_DEPTH} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{4} & power of two, 2 or more & Number of entries of the write response FIFO. The FIFO module stops elaboration for any other value. The test suite uses depths of 4 and more.\\
\code{AR_DEPTH} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{4} & power of two, 2 or more & Number of entries of the read address FIFO. The FIFO module stops elaboration for any other value. The test suite uses depths of 4 and more.\\
\code{R_DEPTH} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{8} & power of two, 2 or more & Number of entries of the read data FIFO. The FIFO module stops elaboration for any other value. The test suite uses depths of 4 and more.\\
\code{SYNC_STAGES_TO_S} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{2} & 2 or more & Pointer synchroniser ranks of the write response and read data FIFOs, and ranks of the reset synchroniser of the \code{s_clk_i} domain.\\
\code{SYNC_STAGES_TO_M} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{2} & 2 or more & Pointer synchroniser ranks of the write address, write data and read address FIFOs, and ranks of the reset synchroniser of the \code{m_clk_i} domain.\\
\end{longtable}
